summary: Approval: Scoped encrypted payload sample provisioning for compliance validation
description:
Purpose:
Request approval to extract a scoped, sampled set of production request/response pairs (redacted and KMS-wrapped) for an upcoming third-party compliance evidence check. This is NOT a full session export; it is a narrow slice targeted by time window and request fingerprinting patterns.

Scope:
- Time window: 2026-03-01 00:00:00 UTC — 2026-03-07 23:59:59 UTC (7 days)
- Targeted customers: internal test customers + two enterprise customers with signed NDAs (IDs to be provided to approvers separately via secure channel)
- Sample size: up to 250 unique request/response pairs, prioritized by observed error rate and variance in tokenization across affected models.

Data minimization and transformations:
- Remove user-identifying fields via the redaction script (field_map_v3).
- Replace any detected email/phone patterns with deterministic tokens.
- KMS-wrap each payload before extraction; extract only ciphertext blobs plus a minimal metadata CSV (hash-only identifiers, model,id-hash,timestamp).
- No raw keys or plaintext left on any intermediary host.

Controls and guardrails requested:
- Two-person control for the extraction run: operator (infra-runner) + approver (security lead) to sign the run command via vault-signed token.
- Extraction to occur in a segregated ephemeral pod in prod with no external network egress; files written to a short-lived S3 bucket encrypted with customer-managed key and lifecycle set to auto-delete after 7 days.
- Audit logging enabled (who/when/command) with links recorded in the ticket.

Deliverable:
- A KMS-wrapped tar.gz containing the sample blobs (ciphertext) and metadata CSV, plus a short README of the redaction transformations applied.
- A verification manifest and SHA256 of the archive.

Retention and follow-ups:
- Extracted artifacts to be retained for maximum 7 days in the secure bucket; then automatic delete.
- If compliance requests longer retention, a separate approval flow required.

Approval rationale:
- Third-party validator requires representative examples to confirm redaction rules and to validate retention controls. No other viable way to demonstrate production-redaction fidelity without a data slice.

Requested by: Compliance engineering (internal), ticketed per DPA operator checklist.

Requested approvers: Security Engineering lead, Privacy & Compliance owner, and Infra Oncall (for scheduling).
steps_to_provision: 1) Approver sign-off in ticket comments (security + privacy).
2) Infra operator picks 7-day window and builds a fingerprint query (sha256 of request prefix) limited to sample size 250.
3) Run redaction script field_map_v3 against a stage-like replay on a snapshot; review sample of 10 in-person with approvers before prod run.
4) Execute extraction tool (prod-extract v2.1) with --kms-wrap --no-egress flags in ephemeral pod; operator and approver must present signed tokens.
5) Upload artifacts to kms-encrypted S3 path under s3://redwood-compliance-samples/INT-418273/ and attach SHA256 manifest to this ticket.
6) Security reviews manifest and marks ticket with 'Artifact Verified' then lifecycle policy auto-deletes after 7 days.
